last.verdict: Investors cheered a first profit and a huge revenue forecast, despite soaring spending.

reasons.label: Huge revenue forecast
reasons.text: Next-quarter revenue guided to $33–37 billion, far above the roughly $22 billion analysts expected.

reasons.label: First profit, big beat
reasons.text: Revenue jumped 161% to $14.6 billion, beating estimates by 13%, with $4.4 billion net income.

reasons.label: AI business surging
reasons.text: AI revenue nearly tripled to $7.6 billion and now outsells Starlink's $5.2 billion.

story: SpaceX has reported only one earnings report since its IPO. In August, revenue of $7.8 billion beat estimates, yet shares fell about 7% after hours on heavy AI spending plans. This time a profit and bigger guidance won investors over, though the gain faded within days.
